description: Boggle — shake the 4×4 board of real Boggle dice, find words in 3 minutes, beat your best score.

faqs.a: Words must be at least 3 letters, formed by chaining adjacent letters (including diagonals) without reusing a cube, and must be in the 5,200-word dictionary. The Q cube counts as “Qu”.
faqs.q: What counts as a valid word?

faqs.a: 3–4 letters = 1 point, 5 = 2, 6 = 3, 7 = 5, 8+ = 11. Longer words are where the big scores hide.
The board uses the 16 official Boggle dice with their real letter distributions, shuffled and rolled fresh every game.

howto: Press “New game” to shake the board — the 3:00 timer starts.
Click adjacent letters to build a word (Q counts as Qu).
Press “Submit word” — valid new words score by length.
Find as many as you can before time runs out.
title: Boggle
